results.details: Tested 5 beta values. All gaps positive.

results.details: mu(beta=15) = -0.8827, u_3 = 0.739606. Fundamental rep dominates in deconfined phase.

results.details: m_eff values: ['6.89877739', '6.89877739', '6.89877739']... Max variation: 8.88e-16. Single exponential decay (no excited state contamination).

results.name: T7: Correlation length xi = 1/mu increases toward beta_c
results.details: xi values: ['0.052', '0.076', '0.145', '0.278', '0.589']. Monotonically increasing toward critical point.

results.name: T8: xi -> infinity (mu -> 0) at beta_c
results.details: beta_c ~ 11.42. Smallest positive mu near beta_c: 0.0050 (xi = 201.7). Correlation length diverges monotonically.

results.name: T9: mu -> infinity at strong coupling
results.details: mu(beta=0.2) = 32.57 (u_3 = 1.129621e-02). Maximum confinement at strong coupling.

results.name: T10: Gap ratios gap_8/gap_3 and gap_6/gap_3
results.details: gap_8/gap_3 = 1.992, gap_6/gap_3 = 2.184. Higher reps have proportionally larger gaps.

results.name: T11: Connected correlator ~ exp(-mu*t) -> 0 at large t
results.details: At t = 2 (= 10*xi): decay factor = 6.098635e-09. Cluster property satisfied (factorization at large separation).
